notes: Empty pour arg yields "From what do you want to pour?".
Empty fill args yield "What do you want to fill?  And what are you filling it from?".
pour from a missing object yields "You can't find it!".
pour from a non-drinkcon yields "You can't pour from that!".
pour with no destination yields "Where do you want it?  Out or in what?".
pour X out empties the container: "You empty $p." and "$n empties $p.".

After pour-out, C name_from_drinkcon strips the container's first keyword word (obj->name); a container with no liquid prefix loses its real keyword and can't be re-found. Go now mirrors this in clearDrinkconName (keywords, not short desc) and resolves pour targets via getObjInInvVis (keyword-only).
fill from a non-fountain yields "You can't fill something from $p.".
You pour the <liquid> into the <cont>. Needs a second drinkcon fixture to oracle; multi-container staging follow-up.
You gently fill $p from $P. Needs a fountain fixture to oracle; follow-up.
There is already another liquid in it! / "There is no room for more." Needs two-drinkcon staging; follow-up.
